2026-11-05.homeNewsDetails: Garand will start vs. Philadelphia on Thursday.
2026-11-05.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Since Igor Shesterkin's season-ending injury, the Rangers have relied almost exclusively on Dylan Garand, who returns to the crease on Thursday. The 24-year-old Garand was excellent in his most recent outing, snapping a four-game losing streak and saving 32 of 33 shots (.970 SV%) in a 3-1 win over the St. Louis Blues. He has a 2.57 GAA and a .905 SV% in 12 games (5-6-1). The Rangers enter Thursday's outing as -142 home favourites against a Philadelphia Flyers team coming off a 4-2 loss to the Minnesota Wild.
2026-11-05.awayNewsDetails: Woll will start in New York on Thursday.
2026-11-05.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Woll had a chance to earn more playing time after a poor start to Dan Vladar's season, but he has struggled in recent outings, while Vladar has turned things around. The 28-year-old Woll allowed four goals on 29 shots (.862 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 5-2 loss to the Washington Capitals. He has a 3.13 GAA and .899 SV% in eight games (1-5-2) and has allowed four or more goals in three of his last five games (1-4-0). The Flyers enter Thursday's game as +128 road underdogs against a New York Rangers team that snapped a four-game losing streak in Tuesday's 3-1 win over the St. Louis Blues.

2026-11-05.homeNewsDetails: Vasilevskiy was the first goalie off the ice at Tampa Bay's morning skate.
2026-11-05.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Vasilevskiy is coming off a solid 2025-26 season, winning his second Vezina Trophy, but he hasn't needed to be spectacular to start the 2026-27 season. That said, Vasilevskiy played well in his most recent outing, saving 19 of 21 shots (.905 SV%) in a 4-2 win over the Detroit Red Wings. The 32-year-old goalie has allowed three or more goals in six of his last eight games (5-2-1). Tampa Bay enters Thursday's outing as enormous -429 home favourites against a Chicago Blackhawks team whose losing streak extended to four games after losing 5-3 to the Florida Panthers last night.
2026-11-05.awayNewsDetails: Soderblom is expected to start in Tampa Bay on Thursday.

2026-11-05.homeNewsDetails: Varlamov will start vs. Carolina on Thursday.
2026-11-05.homeNewsFantasyDetails: After being sidelined from November 2024 until the start of this season, the Islanders have used Varlamov sparingly, but he will return to the crease for his fifth start on Tuesday. The 38-year-old goalie saved 20 of 23 shots (.870 SV%) in his most recent game, a 4-3 shootout win over the Nashville Predators for his first win of the season. Varlamov has a 2.40 GAA and .891 SV% in four games (1-1-2). The Islanders enter Thursday's game as +166 home underdogs against the 12-3-2 Eastern Conference-leading Carolina Hurricanes.

2026-11-05.homeNewsDetails: Tarasov is in the starter's crease at Detroit's morning skate.
2026-11-05.homeNewsFantasyDetails: With John Gibson (lower body) sidelined, the Red Wings will likely lean on Tarasov starting Thursday. The 27-year-old Tarasov has been used sparingly this season, but has been excellent when called upon, posting a 1.74 GAA and a .927 SV% in six games (2-1-2). He saved 12 of 13 shots (.923 SV%) in relief of Gibson in Tuesday's 4-2 loss to the Tampa Bay Lightning. The Red Wings enter Thursday's action as +126 home underdogs against a Vegas Golden Knights team coming off a 3-2 win over the Pittsburgh Penguins.

2026-11-05.homeNewsDetails: Hellebuyck was the first goalie off the ice at New Jersey's morning skate.
2026-11-05.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Hellebuyck hasn't had to be spectacular since joining the Devils, but remains undefeated and will return to the crease on Thursday. The 33-year-old American goalie is coming off his weakest performance of the season, allowing three goals on 21 shots (.857 SV%), but still winning in a 4-3 shootout over the Edmonton Oilers. In three games (3-0-0), Hellebuyck has a 1.95 GAA and .900 SV%. The Devils enter Thursday's outing as sizeable -198 home favourites against a St. Louis Blues team coming off a 3-1 loss to the New York Rangers.
2026-11-05.awayNewsDetails: Binnington will start in New Jersey on Thursday.
2026-11-05.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Binnington has appeared in at least half of the Blues' games since his rookie season in 2018-19, but ongoing struggles have limited him to just four starts through 15 games in 2026-27. That said, the 33-year-old Binnington is coming off his best performance of the season, saving 19 of 21 shots (.906 SV%) in a 2-0 loss to the Montreal Canadiens. Still, he has an ugly 4.11 GAA and .846 SV% in four games (1-3-0). The Blues enter Thursday's game as +187 road underdogs against a thriving New Jersey Devils team that is 6-1-0 in their last seven games.

2026-11-05.homeNewsDetails: Silovs will start vs. Boston on Thursday.
2026-11-05.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Silovs was serviceable in his previous game, saving 20 of 23 shots (.870 S%), but came up short in a 3-2 loss to the Vegas Golden Knights. The 25-year-old Latvian goalie already has two shutouts this season, but has been inconsistent on most nights, posting a pedestrian 2.98 GAA and .888 SV% in 10 games (5-4-1). The Penguins enter Thursday's game as slight -103 home underdogs against a Boston Bruins team that is 7-2-1 in their last 10 games.

2026-11-05.homeNewsDetails: Dobes will start vs. Utah on Thursday.
2026-11-05.homeNewsFantasyDetails: After a breakout 2025-26 season that continued with an impressive postseason run, Dobes has struggled early in 2026-27. As a result, the Canadiens have often turned to Jacob Fowler, who has dazzled in most games but is coming off a dreadful outing in which he allowed four goals in the final three minutes of regulation, which could potentially open a door for Dobes. The 25-year-old Dobes was serviceable in his previous outing, albeit lightly tested, saving 17 of 19 shots (.895 SV%) in a 5-2 win over the Dallas Stars. The Canadiens enter Thursday's game as slight +106 home underdogs against a Utah Mammoth team coming off a 3-2 win over the Toronto Maple Leafs.
2026-11-05.awayNewsDetails: Cossa is expected to start vs. Montreal on Thursday.
2026-11-05.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Cossa had a shaky start to the season, but has strung together some quality performances that could help him secure more playing time, especially if his counterpart, Karel Vejmelka, continues to struggle. The 23-year-old Cossa was excellent in his most recent outing, saving 27 of 29 shots (.931 SV%) in a 3-2 win over the Toronto Maple Leafs. He has won three straight games. The Mammoth enter Thursday's game as slight -111 road favourites against a Montreal Canadiens team that has scored four or more goals in three straight games (0-2-1).

2026-11-05.homeNewsDetails: Talbot will start vs. Dallas on Thursday.
2026-11-05.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Jet Greaves was expected to carry a heavy workload this season, but some rough outings have awarded Talbot some extra playing time. The 39-year-old Talbot was excellent in his most recent outing, saving 27 of 29 shots (.931 SV%) in a 7-2 win over the Colorado Avalanche. In his last five appearances (3-2-0), Talbot has an impressive 2.00 GAA and a .929 SV%. The Blue Jackets enter Thursday's contest as +120 home underdogs against a Dallas Stars team coming off a 6-5 win over the Washington Capitals.
2026-11-05.awayNewsDetails: DeSmith will start in Columbus on Thursday.
2026-11-05.awayNewsFantasyDetails: DeSmith has played about a third of games over the past two seasons as Jake Oettinger's backup, but has had a lighter workload at the start of 2026-27, starting only three of 15 games. The 35-year-old DeSmith, typically dependable between the pipes, is coming off a poor performance, allowing five goals on 27 shots (.815 SV%) in a 5-1 loss to the New Jersey Devils. He has a 2.94 GAA and an .888 SV% in three games (1-2-0). The Stars enter Thursday's game as -125 road favourites against a Columbus Blue Jackets team they defeated 3-1 less than a week ago.

2026-11-05.homeNewsDetails: Skinner will start vs. Vancouver on Thursday.
2026-11-05.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Jets have struggled in recent weeks, highlighted by poor performances between the pipes following the departure of Connor Hellebuyck, but are hoping to build off a heroic come-from-behind win. On Tuesday, the Jets trailed the Montreal Canadiens 4-0 with fewer than 3 minutes remaining and went on to win 5-4 in overtime, with Skinner saving 18 of 22 shots (.818 SV%). The 28-year-old goalie has a 3.41 GAA and .882 SV% in 11 games this season (4-4-3). The Jets enter Thursday's game as -198 home favourites against a Vancouver Canucks team on a three-game losing streak (0-3-0).
2026-11-05.awayNewsDetails: Merilainen is expected to start in Winnipeg on Thursday.
2026-11-05.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Merilainen boasts an ugly 3.31 GAA and .897 SV% through 11 appearances (2-5-1), yet has unfortunately been the unquestionably most reliable Vancouver goalie this season, outplaying a struggling Kevin Lankinen. The 24-year-old Merilainen allowed three goals on 27 shots (.889 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 4-2 loss to the Toronto Maple Leafs. The Canucks enter Thursday's game as +179 road underdogs against a Winnipeg Jets team coming off an impressive come-from-behind 5-4 overtime win over the Montreal Canadiens.

2026-11-05.homeNewsDetails: Tomkins will start vs. Anaheim on Thursday.
2026-11-05.awayNewsDetails: Brossoit is expected to start in Edmonton on Thursday.
2026-11-05.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Brossoit returned last season after nearly a two-year injury absence and has mostly played in the AHL since, but is currently getting a look in the Ducks' crease. Amid struggles from Lukas Dostal and Ville Husso, Brossoit will tend the twine for a third consecutive game. Brossoit has been far from stellar, posting a 3.50 GAA and .848 SV%, but has yet to lose, with a 2-0-0 record. The Ducks enter Thursday's game as +165 road underdogs against an Edmonton Oilers team that defeated them 5-2 earlier this season.

2026-11-05.homeNewsDetails: Blackwood will start vs. Nashville on Thursday.
2026-11-05.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Blackwood has deservedly earned the trust of Head Coach Jared Bednard early in the 2026-27 season, outplaying counterpart Scott Wedgewood, and will return to the crease for the 12th in 17 games. The 29-year-old Blackwood was solid in his last start, saving 21 of 23 shots (.913 SV%) in a 5-2 win over the Chicago Blackhawks. He has a 2.80 GAA and .894 SV% in 12 appearances (8-3-0). Colorado enters Thursday's game as a sizeable -209 home favourite against a Nashville Predators team coming off an impressive 4-1 win over the Carolina Hurricanes.
